descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S20b Real iOS and Android builds: a phone with the wrong date or time zone shows the same counts; VoiceOver and TalkBack announce a count change

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 'In Today' attendance is kept per day by the server clock, so the dashboard counts follow each server day's attendance. A device with a wrong clock or another time zone shows the same counts (TFA-92587 AC 6; UAT 3.8)
  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3; TFA-92598 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given The same account on a real iPhone and a real Android phone (native builds) and on the web. Each phone's clock is set one day ahead and to UTC−10

When Open both dashboards on each device. With VoiceOver (iOS) or TalkBack (Android) on and a dashboard open, change one patient's status from the web

Then Identical counts and the same In Today residents on every device. The screen reader announces the new count without the physician moving focus. Both care settings

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.8 and TFA-92587 AC 6 for the clock part (date line recorded, judged after Q4); WCAG 4.1.3 status messages for the announcement. A person judges both

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S20b is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S20b

Real iOS and Android builds: a phone with the wrong date or time zone shows the same counts; VoiceOver and TalkBack announce a count change

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa); TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status record-only in newspec-c/results.json → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only)).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Gate TFA-92598 (in progress) and our addition: recorded only. Phone one day ahead in Pacific/Honolulu (re-signed in through its form after the clock change) vs the desktop on the real clock: identical Hospital counts (3 / 1 / 1 / 1) and Nursing Home counts (3 / 2 / 1 / 0) with the same residents listed - including the resident taken off In Today, on both devices (that is known B25, not a clock effect). TalkBack is installed on the image, and the count list is an aria-live='polite' region in code, but whether TalkBack actually speaks the change was not captured (no speech output on the emulator): left for a person with TalkBack / VoiceOver on.

Evidence: 5 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Set aside on dev (Quinn, 2026-10-14): iOS and Android are left out of the dev run, and this needs real iPhone and Android builds (phone clock, VoiceOver, TalkBack).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
